column1: # Zero-at-load globals whose identity is a LINK-TIME CONSTANT - FABLE 2026-09-16
# Each row is a global in the uninitialised tail of .data (from 01F7E400) that a CRT
# static initializer fills with an .rdata vtable pointer. Zero at load does NOT mean
# unreadable: the vtable address is fixed at link time and RTTI names the class.
# Method: decode each of the 1,172 listed functions in the CRT initializer table
#   pair; read the qword before the vtable as an RTTI Complete Object Locator and
#   resolve its TypeDescriptor name. 450 such writes exist; 346 resolve to a name.
# Names are the DECORATED MSVC form, carried verbatim. They are not demangled here:
#   a demangler that guesses template arguments invents names, and this table is
#   evidence. Use `undname` on the third column if a readable form is wanted.
